public_scope: Presentation and selected aggregate facts only.

real_push.dataset: MIT Push Dataset, Yu et al., IROS 2016
real_push.metric: Mean endpoint four-corner RMS, mm. First average repeats within each nominal action, then weight actions equally.
real_push.forecast_inputs: Commanded action and initial state. Future executed-tip logs are not forecast inputs.
real_push.split: All repetitions of one nominal action stay in the same partition.
real_push.scope: One square object and surface. Other sides are not new-object transfer.

reconstruction.metric: Mean foreground PSNR on four reused development views
reconstruction.caveat: Appearance diagnostic, not an independent test or dynamics metric.

reference_fixture.scope: Authored synthetic Gaussian cube. Prescribed kinematic box pusher, MuJoCo solved free-body motion. Video re-renders the completed trajectory.
